quote: Control of severe or incapacitating allergic conditions intractable to adequate trials of conventional treatment in asthma, atopic dermatitis, contact dermatitis
note: Atopic dermatitis (= atopic eczema) is a named member of the list of allergic conditions the drug controls, not merely a setting.

quote: INCRELEX (mecasermin) injection is indicated for the treatment of growth failure in pediatric patients 2 years of age and older with severe primary IGF- 1 deficiency
note: Growth failure is the thing treated (IGF-1 deficiency is the population) and growth delay is a standard synonym of growth failure; the negation only excludes secondary IGFD.

quote: Captopril decreases the rate of progression of renal insufficiency and development of serious adverse clinical outcomes (death or need for renal transplantation or dialysis).
note: The diabetic-nephropathy indication explicitly includes slowing progression of renal insufficiency and preventing dialysis/transplant, i.e. management/prevention of kidney failure rather than a mere setting.

quote: LUMAKRAS, in combination with panitumumab, is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with KRAS G12C -mutated metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC)
note: KRAS G12C-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer is a subtype of colorectal carcinoma and the indication belongs to sotorasib itself (panitumumab is a co-administered drug, not a co-ingredient).

quote: Topotecan is indicated for the treatment of patients with metastatic carcinoma of the ovary after failure of first-line or subsequent therapy.
note: Metastatic carcinoma of the ovary is an exact synonym of the edge disease.

quote: Rolufta is indicated as a maintenance bronchodilator treatment to relieve symptoms in adult patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
note: Maintenance bronchodilator treatment of COPD is management of the disease itself; the bronchodilator indication is attributable to umeclidinium and appears on a single-ingredient product as well as combinations.

quote: reduces swelling of nasal passages temporarily relieves sinus congestion and pressure temporarily relieves nasal congestion due to the common cold, hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies
note: Nasal congestion appears only in the decongestant-style label texts (nasal swelling, sinus pressure, freer breathing), while every plain loratadine use lists sneezing, runny nose and itchy eyes without congestion, so the claim belongs to a decongestant partner ingredient.

quote: There are no controlled trials demonstrating risk reduction with nebivolol tablets.
note: The only indication is hypertension; myocardial infarction appears in generic class background text about blood-pressure lowering (with an explicit disclaimer that nebivolol has not shown risk reduction) and in warnings, not as a target.

quote: They are also indicated in chronic anterior uveitis and corneal injury from chemical, radiation or thermal burns, or penetration of foreign bodies.
note: Chronic anterior uveitis is named directly as an indication, and iritis/iridocyclitis (anterior uveitis) is listed on the systemic labels.

quote: Candida: Septicemia, endocarditis and urinary system infections have been effectively treated with flucytosine.
note: Candida septicemia is a specific form of sepsis listed among the serious infections the drug treats; sepsis is a near parent, not a whole disease class.

quote: Warnings Liver warning: This product contains acetaminophen.
note: Headache appears only on the menstrual-symptom products, which the supplied warnings identify as acetaminophen-containing combinations; the plain antihistamine labels do not claim headache relief, so the indication belongs to the analgesic partner.

quote: Gliolan is indicated in adult patients for visualisation of malignant tissue during surgery for malignant glioma (World Health Organization grade III and IV).
note: The product is a surgical visualisation (diagnostic) agent; malignant glioma/glioblastoma is the setting of use, not something the drug treats, prevents or manages.

quote: Paricalcitol capsules are indicated in adults for the prevention and treatment of secondary hyperparathyroidism associated with Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Stages 3 and 4.
note: The thing treated is secondary hyperparathyroidism; chronic kidney disease is only the underlying condition/population.

quote: Vigabatrin tablets are indicated as adjunctive therapy for adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older with refractory complex partial seizures
note: Refractory complex partial seizures are a form of complex partial epilepsy; the 'not a first line agent' statement limits line of therapy rather than negating the indication.

quote: complicated skin and skin structure infections, including diabetic foot infections without osteomyelitis
note: Diabetic foot infection is a named item within the indicated cSSSI list (and the EMA text lists diabetic foot infections of the skin and soft tissue); the osteomyelitis exclusion only narrows it.

quote: ILUMYA is an interleukin-23 antagonist indicated for the treatment of moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis in adults who are candidates for systemic therapy or phototherapy.
note: Chronic small plaque psoriasis is a more specific form of plaque psoriasis, and narrower edges count as TARGET.

quote: POTELIGEO is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory mycosis fungoides (MF) or Sézary syndrome (SS) after at least one prior systemic therapy.
note: Sezary syndrome is named directly as a treated condition in both FDA and EMA text.

quote: Tapentadol tablets are indicated for the management of acute pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic and for which alternative treatments are inadequate in adults
note: Pain is exactly what is managed; the severity/opioid-requirement qualifiers narrow the population but pain remains the target rather than an over-broad class.

quote: Cabometyx is indicated as monotherapy for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in adults who have previously been treated with sorafenib.
note: Hepatocellular carcinoma is named directly as a treated condition.

quote: ELIQUIS is indicated for the treatment of venous thromboembolism (VTE) and reduction in the risk of recurrent VTE in pediatric patients
note: Venous thromboembolism is named directly as treated (pediatric VTE, plus adult DVT/PE which are its subtypes).

quote: Temporarily relieves minor pain associated with: arthritis simple backache bursitis tendonitis muscle strains bruises cramps
note: Relief of the pain of muscle strains counts as management of the strain under the rubric's osteoarthritis-pain rule, so this is not a symptom swap.

quote: Rebif is indicated for the treatment of: patients with a single demyelinating event with an active inflammatory process, if alternative diagnoses have been excluded
note: The label treats relapsing multiple sclerosis and a first demyelinating event, so demyelinating disease is a near parent that still essentially describes what is indicated rather than a misleading whole-class claim.
Every indication is Parkinson's disease or parkinsonism; attention deficit hyperactivity disorder is not mentioned anywhere in the supplied text.

quote: multiple myeloma, malignant lymphoma (Hodgkin, non-Hodgkin lymphoma), acute lymphoblastic and myeloblastic leukemia, childhood neuroblastoma, ovarian cancer, mammary adenocarcinoma.
note: Acute myeloblastic leukemia is a synonym of acute myeloid leukemia and is listed as a treated condition for high-dose melphalan.

quote: Paroxetine Tablets are indicated for the treatment of social anxiety disorder, also known as social phobia, as defined in DSM-IV (300.23).
note: Social phobia is named explicitly as an indication.

quote: For the treatment of dermatomyositis, polymyositis, and systemic lupus erythematosus.
note: Dermatomyositis is named directly as a treated condition.

quote: Valsartan tablets are indicated for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure in adults and pediatric patients six years of age and older.
note: Single-ingredient valsartan is indicated for hypertension, of which essential hypertension is a subtype, and the EMA text names essential hypertension explicitly.

quote: Treatment of major depressive episodes in adults.
note: Treatment of major depressive episodes is treatment of major depressive disorder by standard synonymy.

quote: For control of severe nausea and vomiting.
note: Nausea and vomiting is named directly as the condition controlled.

quote: Rivaroxaban tablets are indicated to reduce the risk of stroke and systemic embolism in adult patients with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation.
note: Stroke is the event prevented (atrial fibrillation is the population), and prevention counts as a target under the rubric.
The supplied text covers dietary vitamin supplementation and vitamin A deficiency; wasting syndromes are not mentioned anywhere.

quote: Bacterial Septicemia caused by Pseudomonas aeruginosa , Klebsiella spp., Haemophilus influenzae , Escherichia coli , Serratia spp., Streptococcus pneumoniae , and Staphylococcus aureus
note: Bacterial septicemia is named as a treated disease and the label adds that ceftazidime may be used alone in confirmed or suspected sepsis.

quote: The parenteral route is indicated when oral administration is not feasible as in anorexia, nausea and vomiting, and preoperative and postoperative conditions.
note: Anorexia appears only as a circumstance justifying parenteral dosing for pyridoxine deficiency, not as a treated condition, and the symptom anorexia is not the disorder anorexia nervosa.

quote: 1.4 Treatment of Pulmonary Embolism ELIQUIS is indicated for the treatment of adults with pulmonary embolism (PE).
note: Pulmonary embolism is named directly as a treated condition.

quote: Also for the treatment of conditions in which iron deficiency and vitamin C deficiency occur together, along with a deficient intake or increased need for B-Complex vitamins
note: Scurvy (vitamin C deficiency) appears only on multi-ingredient iron/vitamin C/B-complex products and belongs to the vitamin C component; folic acid's own indication is folate deficiency.

quote: TrophAmine® is indicated for the nutritional support of infants (including those of low birth weight) and young pediatric patients requiring TPN
note: Low-birth-weight/small-for-gestational-age infants are the population receiving parenteral nutritional support, not a condition the amino acid treats; SGA itself appears only in warnings.

quote: Phendimetrazine tartrate extended-release capsules are indicated in the management of exogenous obesity as a short term adjunct (a few weeks) in a regimen of weight reduction
note: Exogenous obesity is named directly as the condition managed.
